name: YoApy Social Poster
author: YoApy

sections.description:
YoApy Social Poster is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to schedule and publish posts directly to major social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok. With an intuitive interface, you can easily manage your social media content from within your WordPress dashboard.

Key Features:
* Schedule posts to multiple social networks simultaneously
* Support for Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok
* Easy-to-use interface with real-time previews
* Automatic character limit enforcement
* Media management for images and videos
* Detailed logging and error reporting
* Multi-language support

Perfect for bloggers, marketers, and businesses looking to streamline their social media workflow and maintain a consistent posting schedule across multiple platforms.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/yoapy-social-poster directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings->YoApy Social Poster screen to configure the plugin
  4. Enter your YoApy API credentials
  5. Start scheduling and publishing posts!
sections.faq:
Do I need YoApy API credentials?

Yes, you need to create a free account at yoapy.com and generate API credentials to use this plugin.

Which social networks are supported?

Currently, the plugin supports Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.

Can I schedule posts in advance?

Yes, you can schedule posts to be published at any future date and time.
